Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 1
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner initially misattributed “The Bacchanal of the Andrians” to Nicolas Poussin (anchoring the solution to Rome) instead of recognizing that the standardly titled work is by Titian (who died in Venice). This misidentification set the investigation on the wrong city and narrative (why Roncalli left Rome) and persisted despite later evidence pointing to Titian, leading toward an incorrect solution.
